text: Small steps every day add up to big changes.
zh: 每天一小步，积累成大改变。
author: HabitDaily

text: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
zh: 开始不必很厉害，但想变厉害就得先开始。
author: HabitDaily

text: A habit is a promise you keep to yourself.
zh: 习惯，是你对自己守住的承诺。
author: HabitDaily

text: Do it today, and tomorrow will thank you.
zh: 今天做了，明天的你会感谢自己。
author: HabitDaily

text: Progress, not perfection.
zh: 要进步，不要完美。
author: HabitDaily

text: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
zh: 种树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。
author: Proverb

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
zh: 千里之行，始于足下。
author: Laozi

text: Drops of water wear away the stone.
zh: 水滴石穿。
author: Proverb

text: Missing one day is an accident. Missing two is the start of a new habit.
zh: 漏掉一天是意外，漏掉两天就是新习惯的开始。
author: HabitDaily

text: Make it easy, make it small, make it daily.
zh: 做得简单，做得小，每天都做。
author: HabitDaily

text: Motivation gets you going. Habit keeps you going.
zh: 动力让你出发，习惯让你坚持。
author: HabitDaily

text: Five minutes is better than zero minutes.
zh: 五分钟也比零分钟强。
author: HabitDaily

text: Your future is hidden in your daily routine.
zh: 你的未来，藏在每天的日常里。
author: HabitDaily

text: Don't break the chain.
zh: 别让连续打卡断掉。
author: HabitDaily

text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
zh: 从你所在之处开始，用你所有的，做你能做的。
author: Arthur Ashe

text: Well begun is half done.
zh: 好的开始是成功的一半。
author: Aristotle

text: Little by little, one travels far.
zh: 一点一点，也能走得很远。
author: Proverb

text: Consistency beats intensity.
zh: 坚持胜过用力过猛。
author: HabitDaily

text: Be a little better than yesterday.
zh: 比昨天好一点点就够了。
author: HabitDaily

text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
zh: 领先的秘诀，就是先开始。
author: Proverb

text: Show up, even on the hard days.
zh: 难熬的日子，也要到场。
author: HabitDaily

text: What you do every day matters more than what you do once in a while.
zh: 每天做的事，比偶尔做的事更重要。
author: HabitDaily

text: Tiny wins are still wins.
zh: 小胜利也是胜利。
author: HabitDaily

text: Rest if you must, but don't quit.
zh: 累了可以歇一歇，但别放弃。
author: HabitDaily

text: Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement.
zh: 习惯是自我提升的复利。
author: HabitDaily

text: Plan the day, then work the plan.
zh: 先规划今天，再按计划去做。
author: HabitDaily

text: Water the plant, not the weeds.
zh: 浇灌花朵，别浇灌杂草。
author: HabitDaily

text: Every check-in is a vote for the person you want to be.
zh: 每一次打卡，都是为想成为的自己投下一票。
author: HabitDaily

text: Slow progress is still progress.
zh: 慢慢进步也是进步。
author: HabitDaily

text: The habit you build today is the life you live tomorrow.
zh: 今天养成的习惯，就是明天过的生活。
author: HabitDaily

text: Make your bed, start your day.
zh: 叠好被子，开始新的一天。
author: HabitDaily

text: Learn something small every day.
zh: 每天学一点点。
author: HabitDaily

text: A good day starts the night before.
zh: 美好的一天从前一晚开始。
author: HabitDaily

text: Focus on the next step, not the whole staircase.
zh: 专注于下一级台阶，而不是整段楼梯。
author: HabitDaily

text: Celebrate the streak, forgive the gap.
zh: 为连续打卡庆祝，也原谅偶尔的中断。
author: HabitDaily

text: It always seems impossible until it is done.
zh: 事情做成之前，看起来总是不可能。
author: Nelson Mandela

text: Do one thing well today.
zh: 今天把一件事做好。
author: HabitDaily

text: Energy flows where attention goes.
zh: 注意力在哪里，能量就在哪里。
author: Proverb

text: The days are long, but the years are short.
zh: 日子很长，岁月很短。
author: Proverb

text: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
zh: 对自己耐心一点，成长需要时间。
author: HabitDaily

text: Effort today, results someday.
zh: 今天的努力，总有一天会有结果。
author: HabitDaily

text: Make room for what matters.
zh: 给重要的事留出空间。
author: HabitDaily

text: Habits shape the day. Days shape the year.
zh: 习惯塑造每一天，每一天塑造一整年。
author: HabitDaily

text: Begin again, as many times as it takes.
zh: 需要多少次，就重新开始多少次。
author: HabitDaily

text: The hardest part is opening the app. You already did.
zh: 最难的是打开这个 App，你已经做到了。
author: HabitDaily

text: Keep it simple. Keep it going.
zh: 保持简单，保持下去。
author: HabitDaily

text: A little each day is better than a lot someday.
zh: 每天一点，好过某天很多。
author: HabitDaily

text: Your only competition is who you were yesterday.
zh: 你唯一的对手，是昨天的自己。
author: HabitDaily

text: Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
zh: 自律，是选择最想要的，而不是眼下想要的。
author: HabitDaily

text: Good things take time, so start today.
zh: 好事需要时间，所以今天就开始。
author: HabitDaily

text: Every expert was once a beginner.
zh: 每个高手都曾是新手。
author: Proverb

text: Don't count the days. Make the days count.
zh: 别数日子，让每一天都有意义。
author: Proverb

text: Breathe, stretch, begin.
zh: 深呼吸，伸个懒腰，开始吧。
author: HabitDaily

text: One page a day is a book a month.
zh: 每天一页，一个月就是一本书。
author: HabitDaily

text: Small habits, big future.
zh: 小习惯，大未来。
author: HabitDaily

text: Showing up is half the work.
zh: 到场，就完成了一半。
author: HabitDaily

text: Today is a good day to keep a promise.
zh: 今天是守住承诺的好日子。
author: HabitDaily

text: The chain grows one link at a time.
zh: 链条一环一环地变长。
author: HabitDaily

text: Make it a habit, and it stops being hard.
zh: 变成习惯，就不再难了。
author: HabitDaily

text: See you tomorrow. Same time, same habit.
zh: 明天见。同一时间，同一个习惯。
author: HabitDaily
